notes: Same w1 cell as droso_small_window_v1 (1 kb window, 500 bp stride, 80 windows = 80 kbp per optimizer update) but run as micro_batch 80 x grad_accum 1 instead of 4 x 20, with bf16 autocast, for ~8x throughput on a 20 GB A4500. The model has LayerNorm only, so the update size is unchanged. Dropout 0: with dropout 0.1, seeds 43/44 collapsed in eval mode (residual dropout in layers 4-5; val mean AP 0.75 eval vs 0.90 with dropout on) and early-stopped at epochs 8/5.
